admin_host.title: Admin host name
admin_host.description: FQDN of the GoPhish admin interface (web UI + REST API), published through Traefik.

phish_host.title: Phishing host name
phish_host.description: FQDN under which the phishing landing pages are served. Must differ from the admin host.

contact_address.title: Contact address
contact_address.description: Optional address shown to recipients who report a phishing e-mail. Free text (usually an e-mail address).

lets_encrypt.title: Request Let's Encrypt certificates
lets_encrypt.description: Issue TLS certificates for both host names via Traefik.
